answers.rationale: The effective_rate relation establishes job J1 at 240.0 per hour under service code TOW, matching the named rate_card rate.
The job_charge relation establishes a charge of 2280.0 for job J2, computed as 8 hours at 240/hr plus 1 hour of overtime at 1.5x.
The tow_job relation records two jobs for vessel V-BAY: J2 at berth B4 and J5 at berth B12.
Seven jobs appear in tow_job but only four have established entries in billable_hours (J1–J4). Jobs J5, J6, and J7 lack an established billable-hours quantity.

Job J7 is marked insufficient_evidence in billing_outcome because B12 after-hours towing lacks emergency documentation. Insufficient evidence is not established as false, so a documented emergency is not confirmed.
Three jobs occurred at berth B4 (J1, J2, J6), but only J1 and J2 have established job_charge entries (960.0 and 2280.0). J6 has no established charge, so the B4 total is 3240.0.
